HARBOUR & PINE JOINERY LTD
NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, YEAR ENDED 30 JUNE 2026

1. Accounting policies
The financial statements are prepared under the historical cost convention. Revenue is recognised when the
goods are delivered. Inventories are stated at the lower of cost and net realisable value. Equipment is
depreciated over four years on a straight-line basis.

2. Revenue
Revenue of $2,184,600 arises from the sale of fitted joinery in the home market.
